title: Hearty Velvety British Tofu Full English Bake
description: A shojin-friendly, full English breakfast-inspired bake featuring charred, velvety tofu in a cast-iron skillet, perfect for a light and satisfying meal. This dish is made with mayonnaise and baked to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large cast-iron skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms, bell peppers, and onions to the skillet and cook until they are charred and tender.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the mayonnaise mixture.
Add the tofu to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a separate bowl, toss the cubed bread with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the bread to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top with diced tomatoes.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
